channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Ukrainian drones strike Russia’s Tuapse refinery for third time
item.description: Ukraine targeted a major Russian oil refinery in the Black Sea port city of Tuapse for the third time within two weeks.

item.title: Is a US-Iran deal still possible?
item.description: As the Strait of Hormuz stays largely shut and Washington sends mixed signals, talks run through Islamabad and Moscow.

item.title: UAE leaves OPEC in blow to oil cartel amid war on Iran
item.description: The United ‌Arab Emirates has announced it’s withdrawing from OPEC and OPEC+.

item.title: Gulf leaders meet in Saudi Arabia for first time since start of war on Iran
item.description: High-level GCC summit in Jeddah embodies 'unified Gulf stance' towards the war, Qatar's emir says.

item.title: Qatar says using Hormuz Strait as political weapon is ‘unacceptable’
item.description: Qatar’s foreign ministry spokesman Majed al-Ansari said that the Strait of Hormuz must not be used as a bargaining chip.

item.title: The cost of 76 years of US wars, from Korea to Iran
item.description: Al Jazeera breaks down the human and financial cost of decades of US-led wars and its latest war on Iran.

item.title: What’s in Iran’s latest proposal – and how has the US responded?
item.description: Trump administration signals rejection of Iran’s offer, citing incomplete resolution of Tehran’s nuclear ambitions.

item.title: ‘War crime’: Afghan-Pakistan truce under strain after university strike
item.description: Civilian casualties in Kunar spur tensions as Pakistan denies role, casting shadow over ceasefire and peace talks.

item.title: UAE leaves OPEC in blow to oil cartel during war on Iran
item.description: Announcement comes as Gulf producers are already struggling to ship exports through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Ukraine accuses Israel of receiving shipments of grain 'stolen' by Russia
item.description: Israel's foreign minister says it has received no evidence to support the claim that a vessel carrying grain from occupied Ukraine has reached Haifa.
